svg.title: Asset Passport: Crystal Sword: Blockcraft to Pocket Battlers. Admitted, converted. Blast Block: Blockcraft to Pocket Battlers. Refused at gate 5, Border contract. Emberfox: Pocket Battlers to Blockcraft. Admitted, losses declared.
svg.desc: Three crossings at the border desk between Blockcraft and Pocket Battlers, each checked at five gates in order. Crystal Sword: Blockcraft to Pocket Battlers. Admitted, converted. It hits for 6 of a player's 20 HP (30%), and becomes a Rock-type move with power 30 of 100. Blockcraft's rule says anything made of Crystal is Rock-typed, and the engine derived the Crystal Sword's type from it. Rock beats Fire: double damage. It hits the Fire-type Cindermole for 60. Blast Block: Blockcraft to Pocket Battlers. Refused at gate 5, Border contract. It blasts for 22 of 20 HP (110%), so it would arrive as 110 of 100. Pocket Battlers refuses anything that would knock out a full-health creature (100 HP) in one turn. The border turns it back, and it never arrives. Emberfox: Pocket Battlers to Blockcraft. Admitted, losses declared. Emberfox is a Fire-type creature. Its Cinder Puff has power 45 of 100 (45%). It arrives as a pet with 20 of 20 HP, and its Cinder Puff hits a zombie for 9 of 20. Blockcraft has no elemental types, so Emberfox's type advantages are dropped.
